newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell, union said to reach strike pact.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell, union said to reach strike pact.

text.p: A tentative accord to end a strike by members of the International Association of Machinists against McDonnell Douglas has been reached, a company source said Friday.
"It's a tentative agreement," said the source, who declined to be identified.
U.S. House Minority Leader Richard Gephardt had called both sides to meet in his office in a bid to end the dispute over job security, which arose during contract negotiations.
Over 6,000 members of the union had been on strike against McDonnell Douglas since June 5.
On Aug 16, union officials halted contract negotiations, saying the company was unwilling to bargain on job security.
The negotiations which brought an apparent end to the stoppage were conducted by the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service.
